TC-07/S17.method: local Playwright spec, fresh @roundai.test physician(s), no model call (tripwire clean) (newspec-c/te-tc07-send.spec.ts, run twice), sender + recipient + outsider accounts
TC-07/S17.title: Send cannot leak: no address or email in the flow, never to yourself, one delivery per tap, no outsider access
TC-07/S17.detail: Pass: no mailto / SMS / share, no list of accounts (an exact-email box is the stated design, TFA-92585 AC 13 — the matrix's 'no email field' is superseded); own email refused ('That's your own email…'); someone@example.com refused ('No Round Companion account with this email'); outsider opening /handoffs/<id> sees 'This handoff isn’t available to you.' and nothing of the list, API read null, no inbox row; recipient cannot read or change the sender's charts through the API. FAIL (2/2 runs): Hospital — two taps on the final Send within the same moment (two click events back to back) create TWO records on each side (sender Sent +2, recipient inbox 2). Nursing Home with a Playwright dblclick (two clicks a few ms apart): 1 record. The button is disabled only after React re-renders with sending=true, so a second tap before that sends again.
